required_fixes: Fix response fingerprint volatility: the browser-captured composite fingerprint (fingerprint_changed) is true on ALL 260 episodes, making the composite detector (wal_changed OR logical_changed OR fingerprint_changed) always return true. The volatile header exclusion (Date, Server, X-Cache, etc.) must work correctly for browser CDP captures, not just urllib captures.

Fix capture stability gate: the gate checks 'all_identical' (vector AND fingerprint AND logical) but the prereg specifies 'byte-identical' meaning WAL vector only. The gate should check vector_identical only, and the planned 20 pairs must be produced (only 19 were produced due to interleaving modulo-13 logic).
Fix stability pair interleaving: with 260 episodes and modulo-13, only 19 pairs are produced. Use a fixed schedule or adjust to guarantee exactly 20 pairs.

The experiment halted at Phase 7 (capture stability gate) and never reached arm-blind scoring, independent recompute, authorship checks, or durability recording. A re-run with the above fixes must complete the full matrix.
validity_findings: Detector compromise (critical): A-DETECTOR-OUTPUT.jsonl shows fingerprint_changed=true for all 260 episodes across ALL arms (positive, null, liveness, blindspot). Consequently detected=true for all 260 episodes. The composite detector cannot discriminate between any arms because the fingerprint component fires on every capture.

Fingerprint volatility root cause: The oracle_scorer.response_fingerprint excludes headers case-insensitively (Date, Server, X-Cache, etc.), but the browser CDP capture path (_browser_composite) applies the same exclusion. Evidence shows fingerprint_changed=true even on stability pairs where only 250ms elapsed with no action. The Date header changes between pre/post captures and may not be excluded correctly, or other volatile content (e.g., session timestamps in response body) leaks into the fingerprint.

Capture stability gate mis-specified in code: run_stability_pair computes 'all_identical' = vector_identical AND fingerprint_identical AND logical_identical. The prereg (section 8) states '20 no-action pairs, all must be byte-identical' where 'byte-identical' refers to the WAL byte vector (length-framed SHA-256 over db+wal), not the composite fingerprint. The gate incorrectly fails on fingerprint instability which is a detector implementation issue, not a WAL substrate issue.

Stability pair count shortfall: The interleaving logic '(order_index + 1) % 13 == 0' with 260 episodes yields only 19 pairs (at indices 12, 25, ..., 247). The prereg requires 20 pairs (CAPTURE_STABILITY_PAIRS = 20).

Experiment incomplete: The run halted at the capture stability gate (Phase 7) and never executed Phase 8 (authorship separation checks), Phase 9 (arm-blind label join and derived metrics), Phase 10 (independent recompute), Phase 11 (durability), or Phase 12 (frozen decision mapping). The result.json was written via _write_minimal_outputs with minimal data.
